scenes.heading: Building a repeatable client onboarding and briefing process

sents.d: Building a repeatable client onboarding and briefing process
A structured brief prevents wasted drafts and mismatched expectations.

A vague brief ('write something about our product') is one of the most common causes of wasted first drafts — a structured intake process front-loads the questions that would otherwise surface only after a draft misses the mark.
A useful client questionnaire covers the target audience, the specific goal of the piece, examples of tone they like or dislike, and any must-include points or must-avoid topics.
Requesting existing brand or style guidelines upfront, and asking for a few pieces of writing the client considers 'right' for their voice, gives you a concrete reference instead of guessing at tone.

take: Get a structured brief and voice examples before drafting.
